units.source_text: 不久，记忆中断了。

en.t: Before long, his memory broke off.

units.source_text: 接着，他跌入了长长的、令人窒息的梦境。

en.t: Then he fell into a long, suffocating dream.

units.source_text: 在梦里，他骑着一根用旧了的一次性筷子，在一个陌生的街道上飞翔。

en.t: In the dream, he was flying over an unfamiliar street, riding on a worn-out disposable chopstick.

units.source_text: 骑着一次性筷子，就像骑在小摩托车上，一点也没有不舒服的感觉，

en.t: Riding the disposable chopstick was like riding a scooter, and it did not feel uncomfortable at all,

units.source_text: 可是稍微放松一点，立刻就会失去飘浮力。

en.t: but if he relaxed even a little, he would immediately lose his buoyancy.

units.source_text: 街上，近处是砖红色，

en.t: On the street, the nearer parts were brick red,

units.source_text: 越是往远处去，越是出现朦朦胧胧的绿色。

en.t: and the farther away it went, the more a hazy green began to appear.

units.source_text: 这种颜色的搭配会勾起人们异样的不安。

en.t: This combination of colors stirred up a strange uneasiness in people.

units.source_text: 总算到了兵营似的一溜儿排开的木造建筑物跟前。

en.t: At last he arrived in front of a row of wooden buildings lined up like barracks.

units.source_text: 那里飘着便宜肥皂的气味，

en.t: The smell of cheap soap drifted there,

units.source_text: 他把快要哧溜下去的裤子往上拎了拎，

en.t: and he hitched up the trousers that were about to slip down,

units.source_text: 拾级登上楼梯，

en.t: climbed the stairs step by step,

units.source_text: 进了个只放着一张桌子的空荡荡的房间。

en.t: and entered an empty room with only a single table in it.

units.source_text: 十多个男人、女人围坐在大桌子边，像在玩一种游成。

en.t: More than ten men and women sat around the large table, as if they were playing some kind of game.

units.source_text: 正面那个男的，正在按顺序发着一组牌。

en.t: The man facing him was dealing out a deck of cards in order.

units.source_text: 发完牌的同时，那人哇地大叫了一声，

en.t: Just as he finished dealing, the man let out a loud cry,

units.source_text: 把剩下的最后一张牌猛地放到男人面前。

en.t: and slammed the last remaining card down in front of the man.

units.source_text: 他莫名其妙地接下了，

en.t: He took it, not understanding why,

units.source_text: 那不是一张纸牌，是一封信。

en.t: but it was not a playing card; it was a letter.

units.source_text: 那封信软乎乎的，摸上去手感好奇怪。

en.t: The letter was soft and limp, and it felt strangely odd to the touch.

units.source_text: 捏住信的手指一用力，里面竟喷出血来。

en.t: When the fingers holding the letter tightened, blood suddenly sprayed out from inside it.

units.source_text: 他凄惨地叫了一声，睁开了眼睛。

en.t: He gave a pitiful cry and opened his eyes.
